ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף גִּלָּה לְאֶחָיו מִי הוּא, וְהֵם נִדְהֲמוּ.
ideas.children_en: Joseph revealed he was himself to his brothers when no strangers were around. He showed strong feelings and asked about their father. The brothers were shocked to see Joseph as a powerful man in Egypt and knew he was their brother.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף בָּחַר לִרְאוֹת גַּם אֶת הַטּוֹב שֶׁצָּמַח מִתּוֹךְ הַקֹּשִׁי.
ideas.children_en: Joseph told his brothers not to be angry or sad about selling him. It was God's plan to send him to Egypt to protect their family during famine. God made good out of it and Joseph became ruler in Egypt.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף רָצָה לְהָבִיא אֶת מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ לְמִצְרַיִם כְּדֵי לְהָגֵן עֲלֵיהֶם מִפְּנֵי הָרָעָב.
ideas.children_en: Joseph asked his brothers to tell their father he is alive and rule Egypt. He wanted them to bring him and family to Goshen, a nice place in Egypt where they would be safe and cared for during the remaining famine years.

ideas.children_he: הָאַחִים הִתְחַבְּקוּ וּבָכוּ. לִפְעָמִים סְלִיחָה מַתְחִילָה בְּמִפְגָּשׁ מְרַגֵּשׁ.
ideas.children_en: Joseph was very emotional when he met his youngest brother Benjamin. He kissed all his brothers and cried. At first, they were scared, but when they saw his love and feelings, they calmed and felt better.

ideas.children_he: פַּרְעֹה שָׂמַח לְעָזֹר לְמִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ שֶׁל יוֹסֵף.
ideas.children_en: Pharaoh heard Joseph cry and was happy to know his family came. He allowed the brothers to prepare with their animals and wagons to go back to Canaan. Pharaoh invited them to bring their father and live in Egypt with special help.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף בִּקֵּשׁ מֵאֶחָיו לֹא לָרִיב בַּדֶּרֶךְ.
ideas.children_en: The brothers got ready to go home with gifts and supplies Joseph gave, including wagons and food. Joseph told them not to argue on the way to keep peace after they told him the truth.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב שָׁמַע שֶׁיּוֹסֵף חַי וְהִתְקַשָּׁה לְהַאֲמִין מֵרֹב הַפְתָּעָה.
ideas.children_en: The brothers came to Jacob and told him Joseph is alive and leader of Egypt. Jacob did not believe at first, but when he saw the wagons Joseph sent, he knew the story was true and was very happy.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב הִתְמַלֵּא תִּקְוָה לִפְגֹּשׁ שׁוּב אֶת בְּנוֹ.
ideas.children_en: Jacob, also called Israel, felt his family was back and that's enough for him. He wants to see his son Joseph before he dies, showing a big change in his life.
